identity_tangent_calibration.normalization: per-record relative error, averaged equally across volume fractions

original_phase7_test_regression_monitor.interpretation_note: This pre-existing test split is a regression monitor only, was previously inspected, and excludes identity records reused as calibration anchors. It is not a fresh final test.

scope: Context-only shear tangent candidate initialized from the frozen Phase 6/7 checkpoint. The invariant backbone and original checkpoint are unchanged. The candidate is selected by minimum shear validation objective subject to the configured original-validation regression cap. Identity dP01/dF01 anchors from a previously inspected base identity state are calibration data; all identity records are excluded from the base-test regression monitor. The prior shear test has already been inspected and is development data only. A new independent shear holdout is needed for a final claim.

shear_design.purpose: separate shear-aware fine-tuning; final-test states are excluded from fitting
shear_design.split_unit: deformation state; each state is repeated at every volume fraction

training_config.method: context-only shear tangent adapter with original-data replay
training_config.selection: minimize shear validation objective relative to frozen model, subject to original validation objective staying within the configured regression cap
training_config.targeted_tangent_calibration: equal-weighted identity and low-shear dP01/dF01 relative MSE; each volume fraction receives equal weight
training_config.trainable_parameter_scope: volume-fraction context subnetwork only; invariant backbone frozen
